newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservatives to win by 60 seats - Heseltine.
newsitem.headline: UK Conservatives to win by 60 seats - Heseltine.

text.p: Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine on Wednesday forecast that the Conservatives will win the May 1 election with a 60-seat majority.
Despite opinion polls showing that the ruling party are still trailing Labour, Heseltine maintained his bold forecast.
"The polls are usually wrong, but the Conservative Party is usually right," he told BBC Radio, forecasting his party would win with a majority of 60 seats "nudging up."
"I think people are turning to us, they're listening to us and they realise that we have a booming economy and that Labour would blow it," he said.
